title: Prepare guarded Capacitor web, iOS and Android development wrappers
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. After the owner supplies native app identifiers and the SDK selection is reviewed, add locked Capacitor-compatible platform ports and build commands for the existing web client. Resolve app IDs through runtime or ignored local configuration, fail when required configuration is missing, and never commit production values. Keep web monetization and haptics as no-op adapters. Native project outputs remain local/ignored unless separately reviewed. The referenced Gem Swap project is a tooling example; do not copy its code or assets. Native builds require actual macOS/Xcode/Android toolchains. Report unavailable checks as unexecuted instead of claiming a passing store build or deployment.
acceptance: Web build/typecheck remains independent of native SDK availability; local preview needs no service configuration.
Missing required app configuration fails clearly before native build/sync, and no identifier or secret is tracked.
Platform bootstrap exposes only approved audio, haptic, ad and purchase ports with deterministic no-op fallbacks.
Documentation distinguishes verified web checks from native build commands and owner-supplied toolchain requirements.
